From Ottoman Turkish تراچه (taraça), from Italian terrazza.

From Ottoman Turkish فرانجله, فرانجالا (francala), according to Nisanyan, this is from Italian frangella which lacks any written examples, perhaps a vulgarization of Italian frangere, ultimately from Latin frangere. Compare Ladino frandjola.
